text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And now, taking the stage are Sakura Laurel-san,
who had a spectacular year, and Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Trainer, someone's calling for you!

Together with Sakura Laurel,
I head toward the stage where the MC is waiting.

After the Arima Kinen,
Sakura Laurel and I found ourselves being invited to ceremonies like this quite often.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
“—Those are the details for the event
Sakura Laurel and the others have been invited to.”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Then I'll attend all of them!

Her eager attitude is one of her strong points, but
if she accepts everything, Sakura Laurel
won't have any personal time left.
choice_data_list: Let's pick something that won't be a burden on you.
Let's pick something that won't be a burden on you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
............
Understood.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Then, I choose "Do not choose."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Because I want to share the history
I've woven with you with even more people."

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel-san has accomplished the Grand Slam,
winning both the Spring and Autumn Senior Triple Crowns!
Could we have your thoughts on this achievement?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yes! First of all, please allow me to express my gratitude for receiving this award before everyone.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: And as for my impressions...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: This record is absolutely not something I could have achieved on my own. All I did was run.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Toward my aspiration. Toward the light.
And—toward my dream.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...In life, the "impossible" does exist.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Back when I first debuted, there were so many things my legs couldn't do.
They were so weak, and I never knew when they might break down.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: However, "possibility" does exist.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"If there is anyone out there who has just lost a dream,
please let me offer you these words."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"You still have the power to dream.
You can follow the passions that stir your heart and forge straight ahead."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Even if there are 'things you cannot do,'
there are still 'things that you can do.'"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"And should someone appear who shares that dream with you,
please cherish them dearly."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—Because that person will surely
teach you irreplaceable courage.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Mmm...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Not at all.
I put my all into that speech, so I'm completely satisfied.
choice_data_list: Why don't we take a little break somewhere before heading back?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure?
Then along with tea,
I'd also like some sweet treats.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Please wait--!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Baku-chan?
Chiyo-chan, too...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um... we prepared
a special ceremony as well!
We'd love it if you could attend!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! This is a ceremony honoring the Victory Club alumni
who conquered the Grand Prix!
The attendees will be the two of you and the four of us!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: No! It's a ceremony!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Laurel's been very busy lately,
but a little bird told me that she never turns down a ceremony!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing grand, just a modest little spread,
but I've prepared some sweets and drinks!
Would you like to relax together for a bit...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...! Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
shall we attend this ceremony too
before heading home?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I might just take you up on that pampering.
Yeah, let's let them pamper you a bit.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
...!
Hooray!!
choice_data_list: Thank you all so much for everything, truly.
Thank you all so much for everything, truly

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Not at all!
I've laid everything out over on that picnic mat, so please, help yourself!
And so, right after that, they attended their second ceremony of the day... or rather, an after-party picnic.
